objects.name: Fake Paysafe, Skrill SDKs on NPM and PyPi steal credentials
objects.description: Malicious packages on the Node Package Manager (npm) and the Python Package Index (PyPI) delivered stealer malware to developers and users of Paysafe, Skrill, and Neteller payment applications.
